relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: microglial P2X4 monomeric receptors (P2X4Rs) in the spinal dorsal horn (SDH) play important roles in neuropathic pain

relationships.subject: NP-1815-PX
relationships.evidence_quote: novel P2X4 antagonists, NP-1815-PX and NC-2600, were developed, which demonstrated potent and specific inhibition against rodent and human P2X4Rs

relationships.subject: NC-2600
relationships.evidence_quote: The phase I study of NC-2600 has been completed, and no serious side effects were reported.

relationships.subject: P2X3
relationships.evidence_quote: P2X3 monomeric receptors (P2X3Rs) and P2X2/3 heteromeric receptors (P2X2/3Rs) in primary sensory neurons

key_findings: Microglial P2X4 in spinal dorsal horn and neuronal P2X3/P2X2/3 contribute to neuropathic pain
Novel P2X4 antagonists NP-1815-PX and NC-2600 have been developed; NC-2600 completed phase I
